prompt: How many days of backup history do you keep on the Standard plan?

retrieved_chunks.text: Standard plan: daily backups are retained for 30 days. Pro plan: 90 days.

prompt: What's the cancellation fee if I close my account mid-cycle?

retrieved_chunks.text: There is no cancellation fee. You can cancel at any time from Settings > Billing; you keep access until the end of the current billing period.

prompt: Is my backup data encrypted at rest?

retrieved_chunks.text: All backups are encrypted at rest with AES-256. Backups in transit use TLS 1.2 or higher.

prompt: What's the maximum single-file size I can back up?

retrieved_chunks.text: The maximum size for a single file in any backup set is 5 GB. Files larger than 5 GB are skipped and listed in the backup report.

prompt: Can I restore just one email from a mailbox backup, or does it always restore the whole mailbox?
Do you support backing up a Synology NAS directly?

retrieved_chunks.text: Northwind Cloud Backup supports Windows, macOS, and Linux servers via the desktop agent.

prompt: On the Family plan, how many of the 5 seats can be installed on the same physical computer?

retrieved_chunks.text: The Family plan includes 5 seats, each installable on one device, sharing a 2 TB storage pool.

prompt: What happens to my backups if I miss a payment for 90 days?

retrieved_chunks.text: If a payment fails, we email you and retry the charge for 14 days before suspending new backups.

prompt: Are backups on the Pro plan retained longer than Standard, and are they encrypted the same way?

retrieved_chunks.text: Standard plan: daily backups retained for 30 days.
Pro plan: daily backups retained for 90 days.
All backups on every plan are encrypted at rest with AES-256.

prompt: What's the current refund window, and has it changed recently?

retrieved_chunks.text: [Effective 2026-02-01] Refund window: 30 days from purchase, prorated for annual plans.

prompt: Does the desktop agent back up files that are currently open, and which OS versions are supported?

retrieved_chunks.text: The desktop agent uses OS-level snapshotting to back up files that are open or in use.
Supported OS versions: Windows 10/11, macOS 13+, Ubuntu 20.04+.

prompt: How many devices can I back up on the Pro plan, and is there an overage fee if I add more?

retrieved_chunks.text: Pro plan includes backup for up to 5 devices.
Additional devices beyond a plan's included seats can be added for $3/device/month.
